intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our AI chat feature on getrok.com.

dataCollection.title: What Data We Collect
dataCollection.content: When you use our AI chat, we collect and store the following data in Google Sheets: your chat messages (questions and AI responses), conversation timestamps (date and time), session ID (to track conversation flow), and approximate location (country/region based on IP). We do NOT collect: your name, email, phone number, or any personal identifying information unless you voluntarily provide it in the chat.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content: Chat logs are analyzed to: understand what topics interest potential clients, improve our AI response quality, identify common questions and pain points, generate insights for business development, and evaluate the effectiveness of our chat system. We never sell or share your data with third parties.

dataStorage.title: Where We Store Your Data
dataStorage.content: All chat logs are stored in Google Sheets (Google Cloud infrastructure). Google Sheets provides: encrypted data transmission (HTTPS), secure cloud storage with Google's security measures, and access controls (only authorized personnel can view logs). Data is stored temporarily for analysis purposes only.

userRights.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
userRights.content: You have the right to: access your chat data (request a copy), request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion of your data (right to be forgotten), object to data processing, and withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, email us at qais@seosoft.dk with your session ID or conversation details.

retention.title: How Long We Keep Your Data
retention.content: Chat logs are retained for up to 12 months for analysis and service improvement. After this period, data may be anonymized or deleted. You can request immediate deletion of your data at any time by contacting qais@seosoft.dk.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
cookies.content: We do NOT use: tracking cookies, analytics cookies (e.g., Google Analytics), advertising cookies, or third-party tracking. We only use essential browser session storage to maintain your chat conversation during your visit. This data is cleared when you close your browser.

contact.title: Questions or Concerns
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact: Qais Yousuf at qais@seosoft.dk. We typically respond within 24 hours.
